author.name: TikTok Agent Skill contributors (derived from Jake Schincariol)

description: Nine Claude skills that run a TikTok account: scripts off 18 hook formulas for 1 to 3 second hooks with a scored hook panel, a research skill that finds what is working in your niche and ranks it by outlier multiple, captions with hashtags, a weekly plan, comments, replies, profile score, repurposing, and a humanizer that strips the AI fingerprint before anything ships. Derived from Jake Schincariol's MIT-licensed YouTube and Instagram agent skills.
